records.title: SBI VC Trade — Kashikoin lending service overview
records.note: SBI VC Trade says its lending (Kashikoin) service supports 32 assets, explicitly including XRP, USDC and JPYSC. Customers lend the asset to SBI VC Trade under a consumption-loan contract; the same asset plus fee is returned at maturity. Early termination is unavailable. Rates, terms and capacity depend on each course. A 10% USDC example is specifically dated 2026-04-30 and is not an XRP rate. The public page does not disclose XRP amounts outstanding, borrower demand, utilization, rehypothecation or an XRP-specific rate.

records.title: SBI VC Trade — JPYSC product, transfer restrictions and lending FAQ
records.note: JPYSC is issued by SBI Shinsei Trust Bank and developed by SBI Holdings and Startale Group. SBI VC Trade says JPYSC deposits and withdrawals are not supported at launch; it is account-only pending legal/tax treatment and supervisory confirmation for public-chain circulation. Ethereum is the declared service network, but no external transfer is currently enabled. JPYSC lending is a consumption-loan service, not a bank deposit, not deposit-insured, with no early termination; expected rates are variable and the lender bears SBI VC Trade counterparty risk.
